summary: Wallbox N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing NYSE acceptance of its plan to regain compliance with continued listing standards. The company received a February 12, 2026 NYSE notice for failing Section 802.01B (average global market cap and stockholders' equity). The NYSE accepted the plan, granting an 18-month cure period from the notice date. No special situation event—no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or restructuring—is disclosed. This is a routine compliance update. What to watch: semi-annual NYSE reviews and progress toward the $50 million equity/market cap threshold.
